reason: Review of blood tests. Arun reports increased thirst and tiredness for about two months.
findings: HbA1c 8.9%, fasting glucose 10.1 mmol/L. Kidney function: eGFR 74 mL/min/1.73m², urine albumin/creatinine ratio 3.1 mg/mmol. Blood pressure 142/88.
plan: New diagnosis of type 2 diabetes with early signs of kidney involvement. Start metformin 500 mg twice daily and perindopril 5 mg daily. Referred to a dietitian. Repeat bloods in 3 months.

findings: HbA1c 6.8%, much improved. Potassium 5.8 mmol/L, above the normal range. LDL cholesterol 3.4 mmol/L.
plan: Potassium may be related to perindopril or to a delay in processing the sample. Continue perindopril and recheck potassium at the next blood test. Start atorvastatin 20 mg at night for cholesterol.

findings: eGFR 51 mL/min/1.73m², down from 67 mL/min/1.73m² three months earlier. Creatinine 139 µmol/L. Arun had gastroenteritis with vomiting and poor fluid intake in the week before the test.
plan: The drop is likely related to dehydration. Advised to keep up fluids. Repeat kidney function in 3 months.

findings: HbA1c 68 mmol/mol, risen from 54 mmol/mol over the past 9 months. Arun has been less active since a knee injury. eGFR 62 mL/min/1.73m².
plan: Add empagliflozin 10 mg each morning, which also helps protect the kidneys. Discussed drinking enough water and good genital hygiene. Review in 3 months.

findings: Blood pressure 152/94 on three readings. Total cholesterol 6.7 mmol/L, LDL cholesterol 4.6 mmol/L. Liver tests normal (ALT 23 U/L).
plan: Diagnosis of high blood pressure and high cholesterol. Start amlodipine 5 mg daily and atorvastatin 20 mg at night. Diet and exercise advice given. Repeat cholesterol and liver tests in 3 months.

findings: LDL cholesterol 3.0 mmol/L, improved but still above Grace's target of 2.5 mmol/L. Blood pressure 128/80.
plan: Increase atorvastatin to 40 mg at night. Grace to report any muscle aches. Repeat cholesterol, liver tests and CK in 3 months.

reason: Aching thighs for about six weeks.
findings: ALT 71 U/L and AST 51 U/L, both above range. Creatine kinase 241 U/L, above range. LDL cholesterol 2.2 mmol/L.
plan: Likely a side effect of the higher atorvastatin dose. Stop atorvastatin and start rosuvastatin 10 mg daily. Repeat liver tests and CK in 3 months.

findings: Muscle aches have gone. ALT 33 U/L and creatine kinase 121 U/L, both back in range. LDL cholesterol 2.1 mmol/L.
plan: Rosuvastatin is suiting Grace well. Continue current medicines. Review in 6 months.

reason: Tiredness, weight gain of about 4 kg and feeling cold for several months.
findings: TSH 9.68 mIU/L, above range, and Free T4 9.0 pmol/L, below range. Cholesterol 6.1 mmol/L, LDL cholesterol 4.0 mmol/L.
plan: Diagnosis of an underactive thyroid (hypothyroidism). Start levothyroxine 50 microgram each morning on an empty stomach. Repeat thyroid tests in 6 to 8 weeks.

findings: TSH 4.64 mIU/L, still slightly above range, down from 9.68 mIU/L at diagnosis. Energy is improving.
plan: Increase levothyroxine to 100 microgram daily. Repeat thyroid tests in 3 months.

findings: TSH 7.72 mIU/L, above range after a year of normal results. Free T4 10.9 pmol/L. Daniel started a calcium supplement two months ago and takes it at breakfast together with his levothyroxine.
plan: Calcium can reduce how much levothyroxine is absorbed. No dose change. Take levothyroxine at least 4 hours apart from calcium. Repeat thyroid tests in 3 months.

findings: TSH 3.08 mIU/L, back in range after separating calcium and levothyroxine. Free T4 14.8 pmol/L.
plan: Continue levothyroxine 100 microgram daily. Thyroid tests every 6 to 12 months.
